title: hakea pityophylla
intro: Hakea pityophylla, commonly known as the Rough-fruited Hakea, is a species of shrub in the family Proteaceae. It is native to Australia and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits. The plant is valued for its potential to aid in the management of respiratory issues and inflammation, attributed to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and expectorant. Bioactive constituents present in Hakea pityophylla include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
